message.content: [罪名]故意伤害罪;破坏生产经营罪<eoa>
message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts: They blocked construction, caused violence, inflicted injuries (light injuries), caused property damage (loss of 144,057 yuan). Likely crimes: "故意伤害罪" (intentional injury) for causing light injuries. Also "破坏生产经营罪" (disrupting production and causing economic loss) or "非法侵入他人建筑施工现场并破坏" maybe "破坏交通设施罪"? But they blocked construction and caused stoppage, causing economic loss. In Chinese criminal law, causing loss to a business by interfering with production can be "破坏生产经营罪" (Article 124). Also "聚众斗殴罪"? They led group to block and fight. Could be "聚众斗殴罪" (gathering to fight). However the facts mention they blocked construction, causing conflict and injuries. The main charges likely: "故意伤害罪" and "破坏生产经营罪". Possibly also "非法拘禁"? No. So answer: [罪名]故意伤害罪;破坏生产经营罪<eoa>
